description: This 2020 Chevrolet Equinox LS is a straightforward, sensible compact SUV with 59,721 miles and the right combination of passenger space, fuel economy, and manageable size. It is large enough to handle family duty and road trips without feeling cumbersome in a parking lot or unnecessarily expensive to operate.  Midnight Blue Metallic is a particularly good color on the Equinoxmore distinctive than the endless rows of black, white, and silver SUVs, but still understated enough to age well. The Gray interior keeps the cabin feeling open and practical, while the four-door layout gives both rows easy access.  Power comes from Chevrolets 1.5L turbocharged DOHC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Front-wheel drive keeps the mechanical package simple and efficient, making this a smart fit for someone who spends most of the time commuting, running errands, or traveling on paved roads and does not need the additional weight and complexity of AWD.  The Equinox hits a useful middle ground in the compact-SUV class. It offers a comfortable driving position, a versatile rear cargo area, and enough rear-seat room to serve as an actual family vehicle. Fold the second row when needed and it can handle grocery runs, luggage, sports equipment, or the sort of oversized purchase that never quite fits in a sedan.  At just under 60,000 miles, this Equinox has avoided the high-mileage territory occupied by many similarly priced SUVs from the same model year. It is an appealing alternative for someone considering a Chevrolet Trax but wanting more room, or shopping a Honda CR-V, Toyota RAV4, Nissan Rogue, or Ford Escape without wanting to pay the premium those names often command.  There is nothing complicated about the pitch: attractive color, useful size, efficient turbocharged power, and reasonable mileage in one practical package. If you need an everyday SUV that makes sense for work, family, or a first-time buyer, this Equinox deserves a serious look.  2020 Chevrolet Equinox LS for sale, Midnight Blue Chevrolet Equinox, low
